scripts.dev: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && concurrently -k "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:job" "npm run dev:application"
scripts.dev:frontend: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:gateway: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run dev --workspace gateway
scripts.dev:auth: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run dev --workspace services/auth-service
scripts.dev:user: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run dev --workspace services/user-service
scripts.dev:job: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run dev --workspace services/job-service
scripts.dev:application: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run dev --workspace services/application-service
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate --workspace services/auth-service && npm run prisma:generate --workspace services/user-service && npm run prisma:generate --workspace services/job-service && npm run prisma:generate --workspace services/application-service
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run prisma:migrate --workspace services/auth-service && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace services/user-service && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace services/job-service && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace services/application-service
scripts.db:push: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:push --workspace services/auth-service && npm run db:push --workspace services/user-service && npm run db:push --workspace services/job-service && npm run db:push --workspace services/application-service
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run seed --workspace services/auth-service && npm run seed --workspace services/job-service
